messages:
matt: Quick ask — can someone run the stride-scheduler + KV-shard patch (local reg on long contexts). I replicated a p95 throughput regression when batch_stride >= 64 with fusion enabled. Can we run a comparison across flash vs paged attention and fusion on/off?

priya: pinging eng-runtime. I can queue it. which commit and exact flags? want both H100 and A100 runs?

matt: commit: abc1234def (branch: runtime/kv-shard-stride). Flags I used: `--batch-stride=64 --kv-shard=2 --fusion=on --seq-len=32k --microbatch=16`. Test harness: `tools/perf/run_bench.py --model=hf/gpt-4k-mocked --iters=200`.

kevin: I can schedule. i'll run on 4xA100-80G (rtx-04) and 8xH100-80G racks. Will collect p50/p75/p95, mem highwater, and GPU util. Add `--trace-kv` if you want KV access profile. ETA ~45m per config.

perf-bot: Job queued: #4123 (rtx-04) by priya. Starting when node free.

ashley: quick code-note from reading the PR: kernel.c inlined temp buffer allocation for fused path — that tends to fragment when paged-attn falls back. I left a comment on PR #449 to hoist buffer to runtime arena.

priya: first run (fusion=on, kv_shard=2) finished on A100. Got odd P95 spike at batch sizes >16: p50=92ms, p75=140ms, p95=1.22s. GPU mem steady ~72GB. Attaching terse logs: `logs/4123/a100/fusion-on.log`.

matt: thanks. can you rerun with `--fusion=off` and `--kv-shard=1` for a quick A/B? also include per-token lat (mean/std) if possible.

kevin: scheduled rerun. Note: paged-attn coldstart warming seems to hit at first token fetch ~120ms which can blow up p95 on tiny workloads. Suggest a warmup pass of 8 tokens before measuring.

ashley: i'll push micro-patch to prefill KV pages on startup to reduce cold misses in paged path — small change, low risk. Will link PR once pushed.

priya: rerun results (fusion=off, kv_shard=1): p50=88ms, p75=130ms, p95=160ms. So fusion on + kv_shard=2 seems to interact badly for large stride. attaching `logs/4123/a100/fusion-off.log`.

matt: that divergence is helpful. two action items: 1) ashley, your prefill patch + a warmup pass; 2) kevin/priya, full matrix across H100/A100 with fusion variants (off, stitch, fused) and batch_stride [32,64,128]. please include memory fragmentation ETF (free lists) counters.

kevin: will do. I'll add `--warmup=8` and `--mem-counters=true`. queueing a sweep that should cover all combos; job ids #4124-4129.

perf-bot: Job #4123 completed. Artifacts: s3://redwood/perf/4123/artifacts.tar.gz. Summary: `perf-bot.ai/summaries/4123`.

matt: awesome, thanks all. tagging @perf-bot to produce final CSV and consolidated p95 diffs when all sweep jobs complete. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: Sweep queued (#4124..#4129). Will post final summary here when done.
